escena: SCENE (production set, the exact moment before a take, no faces): a cinema camera on a tripod head seen from its left side at lens height, the follow-focus wheel and its white marking ring in sharp focus, one hand of the focus puller resting on the wheel at the edge of the frame; a small LED panel on a low stand at the far right, visible and the brightest thing in the frame, throws a hard low backlight that rims the metal edges and the lens barrel, and a thin haze in the air makes that beam visible crossing BELOW the middle of the frame.
